coverage.platform: Linux, Clang 22, C++26; native Windows/macOS branches not compiled

confirmed_fix.defect: Signed int overflow when mapping luma coordinates to chroma on extreme frame aspect ratios.
confirmed_fix.evidence_before_fix: UBSan in actual Degrain implementation: 43228 * 50000 cannot be represented in int.
confirmed_fix.fix: Widen coordinate multiplication to int64_t before division.
validation: Actual Degrain implementation instrumented with undefined-behavior sanitizer: PASS after fix.
Full instrumented build before fix and focused rebuild after fix: PASS with -j$(nproc).
CTest: Degrain extreme aspect ratios, Degrain pipeline, NLMeans pipeline, zimg color-cache regression: 4/4 PASS.
Clang-tidy on changed implementation and test: no errors.

triage: Move warnings refer predominantly to moving base subobjects followed by independent derived-member transfers; AVPointer moves only its own pointer.
Moved-from Frame access in the DOVI test intentionally verifies the documented empty state.
Optional frame scalers and tone-map graphs are emplaced before use; VMAF mean and minimum scores are assigned together.
Policy enum has fixed uint32_t underlying type; complement masks and reserved resource bits are intentional.

RETRACTED: NLMeans samples cannot be assumed bounded to 12 bits. Its caller accepts native 16-bit frames; full-range samples trigger signed multiplication overflow. Fixed in 1faf07d5 with 64-bit multiplication and 16-bit range selection.
Degrain reserve multiplication and grid array extent use small compile-time constants.
Rounding warnings operate on nonnegative sample values; no negative-rounding defect demonstrated.
Virtual cleanup calls in concrete destructors deliberately release resources before base teardown.
Codec pointer sorting uses explicit preference comparators, not pointer-address ordering.
No style-only, speculative or unconfirmed-warning changes applied.

confirmed_additional_fix.defect: NLMeans difference square overflow on 16-bit samples; caller also selected a 12-bit peak for 16-bit frames.
confirmed_additional_fix.before: UBSan: 65535 * 65535 cannot be represented in int, nlmeans_plane.hxx:63; executable exit 1.
confirmed_additional_fix.after: NLMeans plane suites pass with UBSan; 10/12/16-bit full-range samples, several patch radii and strengths match scalar reference.
confirmed_additional_fix.other_validation: 5/5 focused CTests pass; clang-tidy completes without errors and no longer reports production squared-difference multiplication; tests retain pre-existing bounded-stride multiplication warnings.

verified_source_invariants: AVPointer move transfers only m_ptr; AVFilterGraph transfers its independent derived members afterwards.
Frame and Packet transfer Item then independent derived members, and reset the moved-from state.
SimplePlayer color scaler is emplaced before each reported dereference; tone-map graph is emplaced in the missing branch and retained in the other.
VMAF mean and minimum are assigned together before Report checks mean.
AVFormatContext decoder expected.value() and bitstream-filter expected.value() each have a has-value guard.
Policy has a fixed uint32_t underlying type; complement and reserved resource masks are intentional.
Codec stable_sort compares preference, not pointer addresses.
revalidation.invariant_tests: 7/7 existing CTests pass: two HDR preview paths, VMAF remux score, DOVI copy/move, two resource policy checks, delayed filter graph output.
unresolved: Allocation-related exception-escape warnings must not be classified as false positives. Safe::Vector scratch allocation can throw AllocationError and many string operations allocate; broad noexcept contract changes require separate analysis.
Not every individual exception-escape trace has been revalidated or dynamically fault-injected.

A full separate non-PGO UBSan build/test run completed with GPL/nonfree enabled. Strict baseline: 297 passed, 124 failed on external-source UBSan diagnostics, 10 skipped. Unsuppressed recovery diagnostic: 421 passed, 10 skipped; 1525 reports at 252 external-source locations, no owned-source primary report. Strict sanitizer verdict remains FAIL, not clean.
